summary: Climber took a ~30-ft fall at Happy Hour Crag in Poudre Canyon and was left with a suspected open spinal fracture, stranded ~200 ft up the cliff in the dark; ~50 LCSAR/Poudre Fire/Sheriff personnel ran an all-night rescue with a drone and boat ferry across the Poudre River; patient carried out by litter and taken to hospital at dawn
location: Happy Hour Crag, Poudre Canyon (off Highway 14)
responding_agency: Larimer County Search and Rescue, Poudre Fire Authority
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: rescue reported "10 p.m. Monday until 5 a.m. Tuesday" in the July-2021 Kool 107.9 article; Monday = 2021-07-19 (verified). First-hand LCSAR volunteer narrative (rockytalkie) confirms Happy Hour Crag, ~30-ft fall, suspected open spinal fracture, drone + river-boat rescue. Run 720.
